answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making reputation portable but discounted across projects. Like an atlas of trust, an identity's verified work history in one economy can be imported into another, yet at a steep discount that fades like a zephyr over distance, so a fresh fake starts near its nadir with almost no standing. Real standing requires completed, paid, verified work in independent systems, each with its own checks. A Sybil farmer would need a thousand genuine track records to field a thousand credible identities, turning a cheap copy-paste attack into a costly real-work marathon.
